title: bash gate reads redirects, tee and in-place editors, but not cp, mv, rm, truncate, dd, touch or install
detail: Surfaced building v0.237.0. _bash_write_targets now names every redirect, tee, sed -i and perl -i write at its landing path, but cp x design/f/scope.md, mv, rm, truncate, dd of= and touch still change a file the Write tool was refused. Left out on purpose: rm and mv are routine cleanup, so gating them needs a replay of the 61,157-command corpus first to size the false blocks (collect each Bash tool_use command from ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl, run old and new extractors, classify the diff). _command_args and _landing_path already give the argv and the landing path, so each writer is one table entry.
